assertions.subject: Spinal stenosis
assertions.quote: Spinal stenosis is characterized by leg sensory and motor weakness that is relieved with rest (neurologic claudication).

assertions.subject: Spinal tumors
assertions.quote: Spinal tumors may present with unexplained weight loss, focal tenderness to palpation, or other risk factors for malignancy, with approximately 97% of spinal tumors being metastatic.
